prompt_text: Who is the best healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” healthcare marketing agency in St. Louis — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, target audience, and the specific healthcare vertical (hospital systems, physician practices, medical devices, payer, pharma, etc.). I can, however, help you pick the best fit.

Quick guidance and next steps
- Clarify your goals: patient acquisition, physician referral growth, brand/reputation, digital transformation, product launch, enterprise communications, etc.
- Define scope: digital ads (PPC/social), SEO/content, creative/branding, PR, CRM/email, telehealth enablement, analytics.
- Budget and timeline: monthly retainer vs. project; six months vs. 12–24 months.
- Compliance needs: HIPAA, FDA/pharma regulations, state advertising rules.
- Geography: strictly St. Louis agencies only, regional (Midwest), or national firms with local presence?

How to evaluate agencies (quick checklist)
- Healthcare-specific experience and case studies relevant to your vertical
- Measurable results (CPL, conversions, LTV, ROI) and ability to share anonymized examples
- Understanding of regulatory compliance (HIPAA, HCP promotion rules)
- Team composition (strategy, creative, analytics, paid media, content)
- Tech stack & integrations (EHR, CRM, analytics)
- References and client retention
- Clear KPIs, reporting cadence, and contract terms

Red flags
- No healthcare experience or unwillingness to sign a BAA where needed
- Vague or no performance metrics
- No references or case studies
- Overpromising results fast without a plan

If you want, I can:
- Find and rank the top 5–7 healthcare-focused marketing agencies in St. Louis with summaries, relevant case studies, typical budgets, and contact info
- Or recommend a shortlist based on your answers to the questions above

Tell me your top goal, budget range, and whether you want only St. Louis-based agencies — I’ll pull a tailored shortlist.
